description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Add an event extra, such as merchandise or parking, using its attributes. Returns the add-on API response. Use list_addons to review existing extras first.

attributes.description: Add-on attributes, passed to the API as they are. `name` (string), `price` (integer, MINOR units: 1250 means 12.50), `stock` (integer, how many are on sale; null for unlimited), `description` (string), `active` (boolean), `maxQuantity`, `limitPerTicket`, `flagLimitToTicketQuantity`, and `currencies` (`[{currency, faceValue}]`, faceValue in minor units too, one entry per additional currency the event sells in, or the API refuses the call naming the ones that have no price). The API drops a key it does not know, so a misspelling goes through and does nothing: `quantity` is not `stock`.

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to replay a recorded successful request; use a new key for a different change.

name: create_addon

result.description: The API result when it is a list, scalar or null rather than an object.

title: Create addon
